summary: Tennis entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Tennis

emulation.notes: Use the NES/Famicom release in Mesen with original timing and clean scaling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High for NES: accurate emulation with clean scaling.

primary.why: Many ports exist, but the NES/Famicom release is the original Nintendo console version and the cleanest main archive target; later computer, arcade, handheld, Disk System, and e-Reader routes do not have exclusive content requiring a secondary run.
primary.how_to_play: Use the NES/Famicom release in Mesen with original timing, integer or clean aspect-preserving scaling, and no gameplay-changing hacks.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern Virtual Console/Nintendo Classics/Arcade Archives availability may be useful for access, but the platform rows here track the sourced game/platform releases from the article infobox.
